name: gads
description: Google Ads API (accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, budgets, conversions, assets and GAQL reporting, with every other method through the gateway), plus advertising and publisher APIs: Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager, Ad Exchange, AdSense, AdMob, Real-time Bidding and more.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Modifying and deleting tools are listed only when this is on, and every change still asks first unless confirmation is off.

confirmation.title: Confirm before changes
confirmation.description: every-change asks before any change or delete (recommended). destructive-only asks only before destructive actions: deleting, sending to other people, sharing or permission changes, security changes, device commands, publishing, refunds and whole-content replacement. off asks for nothing; deny rules still apply. Change it here at any time.

toolset.title: Toolset
toolset.description: Which tools this server lists. all: every tool (the default). google: the tools that match Google's official MCP server for this product, or a small set chosen here where Google has no server; where that list is not defined yet, all tools, and health says so. curated: the hand-written tools and the gateway tools (api_search, api_describe, api_call); where a product has neither, all tools. It takes effect when the server starts again.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.

ads_developer_token.title: Google Ads developer token (optional)
ads_developer_token.description: Optional. Google Ads access is granted to the Cloud project of your OAuth client; the developer token is no longer required. Sent only when set. Stored in the system credential store, not in a file. Leave empty to use the token-directory file instead.

ads_login_customer_id.title: Manager (login) customer ID (optional)
ads_login_customer_id.description: 10-digit ID of the manager account, without dashes, when you reach client accounts through one.
